name: Making Small Talk
equipment: A notebook and a partner (or mirror) to practice speaking aloud
instructions: This lesson focuses on making small talk — practice these key phrases out loud:
Did you catch the game last night?
This weather has been something, hasn't it?
Anyway, I should get going — great chatting with you.
Try using at least three of these phrases in a short role-play conversation with a partner (or out loud to yourself).
